newsitem.title: UK: Marmite sets ads on the food people love to hate.
newsitem.headline: Marmite sets ads on the food people love to hate.

text.p: The makers of Marmite are capitalisisng on the spread's image as the food that many people love to hate.
Best Foods said it will launch a television advertising campaign on Friday spotlighting the love-hate relationship that many have with the vegetable spread.

One 30-second commercial shows a man enjoying a bath in a tub of Marmite and a fan polishing a jar. Another pictures an elderly man pushing pins into a cushion shaped like the famous Marmite jar, and a jar with a brick attached being thrown into a pond in the dark of night.
Research by Best Foods shows that most of its fans live in the Midlands and the South of England. The Scots think it is unpleasant.
But a liking for the spread does appear to be hereditary - if your parents were brought up on Marmite soldiers, then you probably were too.
